description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h2><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h2> <p>The Quality Engineering team helps Airbnb build high-quality software efficiently. We enable Airbnb engineers to build highly testable systems by building and using tools leveraging AI. We own and continuously improve product test cases, automation coverage, test automation tools, environments, frameworks. We navigate Airbnb’s massive codebase identifying weak spots, and help design and implement testable fault-tolerant systems.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Help Airbnb leverage AI to redefine and accelerate Quality Engineering</li> <li>As an Automation Engineer, you will help us meet this challenge by building and maintaining automation coverage for features and releases. You will work directly with the product engineering team to develop and maintain our test tools, write and test product code, participate in design reviews to architect testable systems, and guide designs and code to enhance modularity and testability.</li> <li>You are eager to understand complex systems top to bottom and thrive working across technologies and codebases. In addition, you excel at working through ambiguity, concept validation, and implementing best-in-class solutions.</li> <li>As a global company, our mission is to develop and maintain the necessary quality engineering processes that scale to meet the needs of both our external customers and internal teams. We strive to ensure that our product and support workflows deliver a seamless experience for guests, hosts, and support agents.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, maintain, and effectively utilize automated tests, collaborate closely with engineering teams to ensure robust test coverage for features and releases, and actively participate in the continuous improvement of testing processes.</li> <li>Contribute to improving existing automation frameworks to support new functionalities and optimize quality and efficiency.</li> <li>Collaborate with CI/CD team to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring thorough test coverage at every stage of development.</li> <li>Demonstrate excellent troubleshooting abilities, isolate issues, and verify bug fixes. Debug issues found during testing and after release.</li> <li>Be a player of our high-performance team to ensure code quality, commitment to craft and operational excellence</li> <li>Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, development, and other QE teams, in a fast-paced environment with short release cycles.</li> <li>Learn and apply AI-assisted tooling (LLMs) to accelerate test creation and maintenance.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h2> <ul> <li>1–2 years of experience in software development or test automation. Recent grads with relevant internship or project experience are welcome.</li> <li>Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Kotlin, Swift, or Java).</li> <li>Some exposure to writing automated tests or working with a testing framework (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Espresso, XCUITest) — through work, internships, or personal projects.</li> <li>Understanding of basic testing concepts, and eagerness to learn the testing pyramid, CI/CD, and quality best practices.</li> <li>Curiosity about applying AI/LLMs to testing and developer productivity.</li> <li>Comfortable collaborating in English.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: </span><a style="color: #000000;" href="mailto:reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com"><span style="font-weight: 400;">reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.</span></p>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p>Every day, Airbnb hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. Since our founding, more than 5 million hosts have welcomed over 1.5 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Chief Business Officer organization plays a pivotal role in driving the company’s growth and expansion efforts worldwide. Our teammates work on commercializing Airbnb’s new and existing businesses, helping Airbnb expand beyond its core offering as a place to stay. This includes recruiting and developing Airbnb’s global supply of high-quality stays, and executing Airbnb’s global strategy in the market. With a focus on business strategy, quality supply and international expansion, the team is leading the way for Airbnb’s continued growth and success in its next chapter.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Global Markets Team, which sits within CBO, ensures that Airbnb is locally relevant and serves the needs of our global hosts and guests, helping regions more efficiently plan and execute growth strategies across supply, demand, and other surfaces in a way that will resonate with our communities.&nbsp;</p> <p>As we expand our business, we look for the best and brightest to drive strategic business decisions. To this end, the team is looking for a Business Operations and Growth Lead to join our Australia and New Zealand team (ANZ).&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p> <p>You will work closely with the cross-functional leaders and teams, and play a key role in scaling our community growth and optimization-focused programs. The successful candidate will report to the Country Manager, ANZ.&nbsp;This role is based in Sydney and will require in-person office attendance, with flexibility on the days and frequency.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li>&nbsp;Align all functions&nbsp; to achieve Australia and New Zealand’s business objectives in partnership with the Country Manager.</li> <li>Drive regular business operation meetings and initiate meaningful conversations - leading weekly meetings with cross-functional project teams to ensure key initiatives are on track in the country.&nbsp;</li> <li>Use all available data sources and tools, internal and external, to analyze macro and micro trends, and present analysis, insights, and actionable plans to Airbnb country and regional leadership team to drive key business decisions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own the day-to-day business analysis.&nbsp; Anticipate changes before they happen and align adjustments to&nbsp; maximize growth and minimize risk.</li> <li>Own the conception, execution, and measurement of cross-functional initiatives end-to-end. Concretely, this means defining a crisp problem statement, articulating the ideal solution to that problem, identifying key dependencies blocking that solution, and then working with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve the solution. These initiatives will span across the demand, supply, and regulatory surfaces of the business.&nbsp;</li> <li>Assist the country Manager in owning the performance narrative for key metrics and deliver the story to senior leaders in a concise and clear manner in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 10+ years of work experience, preferably with combined exposure to business growth, business analytics, and project management in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>A proven bias to action and ability to own a project from conception through to post-mortem.</li> <li>Ability to work in a world of uncertainty and ambiguity - to create clarity from abstraction.</li> <li>A familiarity with AI tools would be considered an asset.&nbsp;</li> <li>A world class written and verbal communicator with the ability to present at all levels of an organization in a succinct, clear and eloquent manner.&nbsp;</li> <li>A proven track record of being able to storytell, influence and rally diverse cross-functional stakeholders against a common mission or goal using both qualitative and quantitative insights.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to not only dive into details to drive execution but also zoom out to contextualize specific recommendations/initiatives within the broader company strategy.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to multi-task by prioritizing work and coordinating required support across various functions to achieve project goals and objectives.&nbsp;</li> <li>Impeccable organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to document processes &amp; decisions made.</li> <li>Experience implementing and scaling initiatives across globally dispersed teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with multiple departments.</li> <li>Hands-on approach, getting things done fast.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfort with manipulating large datasets in excel is a must. SQL proficiency strongly preferred.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Hosting on Airbnb offers a unique way to meet our Hosts’ financial goals but the rewards for opening their home or sharing a passion go beyond their bank account. Hosting also offers the opportunity to impact their local community, share their culture and connect with people they wouldn’t have met otherwise.<br><br>We know that our global community of hosts is one of Airbnb’s most precious assets and we are very intentional on how we nurture the common identity of being an Airbnb Host. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></p> <p>The Community Support org handles tens of millions of interactions yearly, engaging with Airbnb customers by phone, messaging, chat, or social media channels. The group handles hundreds of issues across categories including Cancellations, Account Issues, Refunds, Payments, Reservations, Extenuating Circumstances, Booking &amp; Listing issues, Safety &amp; Claims. The organization is globally distributed with offices in San Francisco, Dublin, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, Manila, Gurgaon and an extensive partner network serving all regions.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a seasoned Forecasting and Demand Planning Analyst on our Community Support (CS) team. This individual is responsible for demand forecasting and long-term planning across multi-channel contact center operations for our Global Operations team. This role ensures the organization has the right resources, at the right time, with the right skills to meet service level objectives while optimizing cost and productivity.</p> <p>The role combines planning, advanced analytics and business partnership to drive scalable, data-driven workforce decisions in a complex, fast-changing environment.</p> <p><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Demand Forecasting &amp; Statistical Modeling</p> <ul> <li>Own short-term, mid-term, and long-term demand forecasting across all Global Operations teams and channels (phone, messaging, email, back-office etc.).</li> <li>Design, develop, and maintain statistically robust demand forecasting models using time series and machine learning techniques (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression-based models etc.).</li> <li>Perform trend, seasonality, and variance decomposition; detect structural breaks, outliers, and demand anomalies.</li> <li>Quantify forecast uncertainty through confidence intervals, error distributions, and bias analysis.</li> <li>Perform scenario modeling for peak demand periods, product launches, growth initiatives, and unplanned demand events.</li> <li>Continuously assess model performance using statistical accuracy metrics (MAPE, RMSE, MAE, bias etc).</li> <li>Establish model governance standards, including documentation, validation, back-testing, and post-mortem analysis.</li> <li>Research, prototype, and implement new forecasting and optimization techniques as business needs evolve.</li> <li>Perform scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to quantify trade-offs between service levels, cost, and utilization.</li> </ul> <p>Advanced Analytics</p> <ul> <li>In partnership with the Analytics and Data Engineering team, design and build scalable planning data pipelines, dashboards, and automate forecasting and capacity models to improve scalability, repeatability, and timeliness.</li> <li>Use SQL and Python to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale operational datasets to monitor forecast accuracy, capacity gaps, utilization, and operational risk.</li> </ul> <p>Decision Support &amp; Stakeholder Communication</p> <ul> <li>Present forecast assumptions, methodologies, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations in clear, executive-ready formats and act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and participate in demand/capacity planning discussions in cross-functional forums.</li> <li>Align cross-functional stakeholders (Delivery, Product, Finance, HR, and others) to embed planning outputs into execution and operational decision-making.</li> <li>Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and best practices in the demand and capacity planning area to optimize cost while maintaining or improving customer experience and service-level outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in demand forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or applied analytics.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.</li> <li>Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and optimization.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and validating forecasting models (time series analysis, exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression, hypothesis testing) and capacity models (Erlang, queueing theory, service-level and utilization modeling).</li> <li>Strong understanding of contact center metrics (AHT, ASA, service level, shrinkage, occupancy); experience supporting large-scale, multi-site, or global contact center environments preferred.</li> <li>Advanced analytical skills with strong proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python and data visualization tools such as Tableau.</li> <li>Experience with WFM tools (e.g., NICE, Verint, Aspect) or planning platforms (e.g., Anaplan) preferred.</li> <li>Strong business acumen with the ability to balance cost efficiency and customer experience outcomes.</li> <li>Excellent communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder influence skills; ability to explain complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, and highly dynamic environments.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Your Location:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position is US - Remote Eligible. We have a huge responsibility to our community of Hosts and guests to be there when things don’t go exactly as planned with their reservations. We have a lot of work to do in the coming years and we are looking for someone who will help us manage all of the things that need to be done to deliver best-in-class services to our community. &nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p> <p>As a Complex Claims Manager in the Complex Claims, &nbsp;you will play a vital role in safeguarding the integrity of our Aircover platform by effectively identifying, investigating, and managing &nbsp;the risk and mitigation strategies in resolution of Complex and Large Loss claims.</p> <p>You'll manage partners to influence prioritization, drive accountability, deliver improvements, and scale changes on claims which impact Airbnb. You'll work with internal and external partners to influence prioritization, drive accountability, and deliver improvements. &nbsp;</p> <p>You will work closely with cross-functional teams to manage emerging risks / threats while enabling business growth in various markets. Philosophy will be to identify intelligence / risk gaps and work with other internal risk management teams (such as Trust team, and Safety team), third party adjusters, our partners, Platform Product Management, Global Crisis Management, Community support, Policy, Privacy Legal teams to strengthen Airbnb’s platform.</p> <p>You will be reporting at Monthly, Quarterly and Annual Business Reviews for your area. You will serve as a thought leader with stakeholders such as Trust, Legal, Privacy, Safety, Product Management, Policy, and understand how the policy/product roadmap impacts risk mitigation of emerging threats.&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Management, Policy, and understanding how the policy/product roadmap impacts risk and exposure mitigation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Builds partnerships and is responsible for engaging in the Large Loss Claim reviews with our insurers on a monthly / quarterly basis depending upon the insurer/market.&nbsp; Works to upskill L6 and L7 partners for growth and development.&nbsp; Supports the team by guiding through complex claims and changes.&nbsp;</li> <li>Management of claims which impact Airbnb Financials and the Captive.</li> <li>Work closely with cross-functional teams to manage the Risk and Exposure on Complex and Large Loss Claims.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate with internal departments, such as other Aircover Ops teams, legal, Trust, CS safety to share claim&nbsp; insights, improve claim handling by our Carriers and TPA’s while developing a Resolution Plan to bring a claim to the correct conclusion.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and legal requirements related to claims handling</li> <li>Mentor to others by simplifying complex information which includes claims knowledge, data analysis, business information, and process obstacles.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; expertise</p> <ul> <li>Exceptional partner and stakeholder management - In depth understanding of business process outsourcing at scale, holding partners accountable for their performance and prioritizing the high impact areas</li> <li>Exceptional performance management at scale - setting clear goals, expectations and actions while continuously driving success metrics</li> <li>Strong data driven decision making with root cause analysis - ability to understand the data to derive to objective decisions&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong communication, data driven storytelling and influencing skills - to present to leadership and collaborate with different stakeholders and manage time sensitive situations, while remaining calm and poised under pressure</li> <li>Organized, structured and resourceful - able to juggle and multi-task, with an attention to detail and follow through even in ambiguous situations</li> <li>Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities at scale - to evaluate procedures and identify opportunities for improvement</li> <li>Strong proficiency in various data analysis and reporting tools to track performance trends (tableau, salesforce, SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, etc.)</li> </ul>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p>Airbnb a pris le jour en 2007 lorsque deux Hôtes ont accueilli trois invités dans leur maison de San Francisco, et compte depuis lors plus de 4 millions d'Hôtes qui ont accueilli plus d'un milliard d'invités dans presque tous les pays du monde. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.</p> <p><strong>La communauté qui vous attend :</strong></p> <p>L'équipe AirCover est chargée de concevoir, de créer, de lancer et de gérer l'activité AirCover au sein d'Airbnb. On a l'énorme responsabilité envers notre communauté d'hôtes et de voyageurs d'être présents quand leurs réservations ne se déroulent pas exactement comme prévu. On a beaucoup de travail à accomplir dans les prochaines années et on cherche une personne qui nous aidera à gérer tout ce qui doit être fait pour offrir des services exceptionnels à notre communauté.</p> <p><strong>Votre contribution&nbsp;:</strong></p> <p>En tant que gestionnaire des réclamations complexes, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la protection de l'intégrité de notre plateforme Aircover en déterminant, en étudiant et en gérant efficacement les stratégies de risque et d'atténuation pour résoudre les réclamations de pertes complexes et importantes.</p> <p>Vous gérerez les partenaires pour définir les priorités, renforcer la responsabilité, apporter des améliorations et faire évoluer les réclamations qui affectent Airbnb. Vous travaillerez avec des partenaires internes et externes pour définir les priorités, renforcer la responsabilité et apporter des améliorations.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes transversales pour gérer les risques émergents tout en permettant la croissance de l'entreprise sur divers marchés. La philosophie sera d'identifier les lacunes en matière d'intelligence et de risque et de travailler avec d'autres équipes de gestion des risques internes (comme l'équipe Confiance et l'équipe Sécurité), des experts tiers, nos partenaires, la gestion des produits de la plateforme, la gestion des crises mondiales, le soutien à la communauté, les politiques et les équipes juridiques de la confidentialité pour renforcer la plateforme Airbnb.</p> <p>Vous ferez des rapports lors des examens mensuels, trimestriels et annuels des activités commerciales de votre région. Vous agirez en tant que visionnaire avec des parties prenantes (p. ex. : confiance, juridique, confidentialité, sécurité, gestion des produits, politiques), et comprendrez l'incidence des politiques et de la feuille de route des produits sur l'atténuation des risques liés aux menaces émergentes.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Journée type&nbsp;:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Gérer, orienter et comprendre l'incidence des politiques et de la feuille de route des produits sur l'atténuation des risques et de l'exposition.&nbsp;</li> <li>Être responsable de l'examen des réclamations pour pertes importantes avec nos assureurs sur une base mensuelle ou trimestrielle, en fonction de l'assureur ou du marché.&nbsp; Vous assurer qu'on gère les attentes des assureurs et qu'on garde une longueur d'avance sur tout problème potentiel de couverture ou relationnel ainsi que sur les changements matériels importants qui pourraient affecter nos prévisions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Gérer les réclamations qui affectent Airbnb Financials et la compagnie d'assurance captive.</li> <li>Élaborer un plan de résolution des réclamations pour pertes complexes et importantes qui incite l'assureur ou l'administrateur tiers à résoudre la réclamation tout en répondant aux besoins des parties prenantes internes.</li> <li>Coordonner les réclamations de pertes complexes et importantes avec les services juridiques, GCM, et de confiance, ainsi que nos courtiers, assureurs et administrateurs tiers sur des cas complexes qui peuvent aussi impliquer des problèmes de couverture ou d'autorisation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Être responsable du rendement et des résultats des compagnies d'assurance et des partenaires dans plusieurs emplacements dans le monde sur les réclamations complexes qui peuvent avoir une incidence sur les limites de la police ou nécessiter d'aviser les courtiers et les compagnies d'assurance en vertu des polices d'assurance.</li> <li>Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes transversales pour gérer les risques et l'exposition dans des réclamations de pertes complexes et importantes.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborer avec les services internes tels que les autres équipes d'Aircover Ops, les services juridiques, la confiance et la sécurité du SC pour partager les informations sur les réclamations et améliorer leur traitement par nos assureurs et les administrateurs tiers tout en élaborant un plan de résolution pour mener une réclamation à la conclusion souhaitée.</li> <li>Assurer le respect des politiques, des procédures et des exigences légales de l'entreprise en matière de traitement des réclamations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Votre expertise :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Analytique :</strong> Posséder d'excellentes compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, permettant de gérer les réclamations complexes et les sinistres importants en identifiant le risque et l'exposition pour Airbnb.</li> <li><strong>Solide connaissance de la résolution de dossiers complexes :</strong> Comprendre les techniques, les méthodologies d'enquête et les aspects juridiques liés au règlement des réclamations complexes et graves.</li> <li><strong>Communication solide :</strong> Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité d'expliquer des sujets complexes à divers publics. Habileté à présenter des enjeux clients complexes et délicats, avec la capacité d'analyser de grands ensembles de données et d'en tirer des conclusions raisonnables.</li> <li><strong>Influencer les équipes transversales d'Airbnb à l'échelle mondiale :</strong> Capacité éprouvée à collaborer efficacement entre les disciplines, les régions et les niveaux hiérarchiques. Solides compétences de négociation et expérience dans la communication de recommandations aux parties prenantes internes et externes.</li> <li><strong>Jugement</strong> <ul> <li>Travailler de façon proactive à l'obtention d'un règlement juste et approprié des réclamations dans des délais raisonnables, en employant des stratégies efficaces de résolution de conflits.</li> <li>Évaluer et interpréter le libellé des polices d'assurance et la jurisprudence pertinente, en tenant compte des détails précis du sinistre, afin de prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de couverture.</li> <li>Coordonner les enquêtes sur les sinistres avec des experts externes pour diverses expositions et gérer le processus de règlement jusqu'à la résolution finale.</li> <li>Déterminer la responsabilité rapidement et judicieusement en fonction des renseignements disponibles, en faisant preuve de pensée critique et stratégique efficace ainsi que d'une prise de décision judicieuse.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Être un ambassadeur des normes de qualité élevées, de l'innovation, de la résolution de conflits et de l'excellence de l'expérience client.</li> <li>Grand souci du détail, minutie dans le traitement de dossiers complexes.</li> <li>Expérience de travail avec des parties prenantes internes et/ou des fournisseurs tiers pour résoudre des différends complexes de manière détaillée, efficace et rapide.</li> <li>Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en couverture de réclamations d'assurance et en litige, avec un accent sur la responsabilité civile et les biens.</li> <li>Solide expérience en matière de polices d'assurance.</li> <li>Agir comme mentor auprès des autres en simplifiant l'information complexe, notamment les connaissances en réclamations, l'analyse de données, les renseignements d'affaires et les obstacles de processus.</li> <li>Établir des partenariats et être responsable de participer aux revues des réclamations de sinistres importants avec nos assureurs sur une base mensuelle ou trimestrielle, selon l'assureur ou le marché. Disposé à être disponible sur appel et/ou à travailler les fins de semaine et les soirs.</li> <li>Capacité démontrée à cerner et à résoudre des problèmes grâce à des compétences efficaces en résolution de problèmes.</li> <li>Capacité éprouvée à négocier avec habileté dans des situations difficiles, tant avec des groupes internes qu'externes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lieu de travail&nbsp;:</strong></p> <p>Ce poste est situé au Canada (possibilité de télétravail).&nbsp;</p> <p>Le poste peut impliquer de travailler occasionnellement dans un bureau d'Airbnb ou de participer à des événements en dehors du bureau (tel que convenu avec votre supérieur).&nbsp;</p> <p>Actuellement, les employés peuvent habiter en Colombie-Britannique, en Ontario, au Québec, en Alberta ou en Saskatchewan. Cette liste est constamment mise à jour, contactez-nous si la province dans laquelle vous vivez n'y figure pas. Si vous travaillez pour une autre entité d'Airbnb, le responsable du recrutement vous indiquera dans quelles provinces vous pouvez travailler.</p> <p><strong>Votre emplacement :</strong></p> <p>En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l’Ontario, le Québec, l’Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.</p> <p><strong>Notre engagement envers l’inclusion et l’appartenance :</strong></p> <p>Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Toutes les personnes qualifiées sont encouragées à postuler.</p> <p>Nous nous efforçons également de proposer un processus de candidature et d'entretien inclusif pour les personnes handicapées. Si vous êtes un candidat handicapé et avez besoin d'aménagements raisonnables pour soumettre une candidature, veuillez nous contacter à l'adresse : raisonnableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Veuillez inclure votre nom complet, le poste pour lequel vous postulez et les aménagements nécessaires pour vous aider dans le processus de recrutement.&nbsp;</p> <p>Nous vous demandons de nous contacter uniquement si vous êtes un candidat dont le handicap vous empêche de remplir notre candidature en ligne.</p> <hr> <p><em>Nous utilisons des outils automatisés pour aider notre équipe de recrutement à examiner efficacement un grand nombre de candidatures. Toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par une personne humaine.</em></p> <p><em>Ce poste est nouvellement créé et ne remplace ni ne pourvoit un poste existant.</em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">Canada Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$83,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$98,000 CAD</span></div></div></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The community you will join: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>At Airbnb, the Growth Marketing team sits at the dynamic crossroads of marketing, engineering, and data science. We’re responsible for driving Airbnb’s business performance by deploying innovative, data-driven marketing strategies.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The difference you will make:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As Growth Marketing Lead, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape Airbnb’s growth narrative in Japan. You’ll be the champion for Growth Marketing channels, translating strategic vision into actionable plans and flawless execution. You’ll identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities, manage complex cross-functional projects, and collaborate with global and regional teams. Your leadership will ensure not only the ongoing success of our core marketing programs, but also the discovery of new areas of growth for your market.</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and Execute Growth Marketing Strategies: Identify and incorporate local nuances to infuse authentic local flavor into Growth Marketing initiatives, ensuring strategies are tailored to resonate with local cultures, preferences, and market conditions.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Leadership: Build strong relationships with regional and global teams, setting and managing expectations effectively to deliver measurable business impact. Establish and optimize operating rhythm and ways of working.</li> <li>Project Management: Partner closely with Regional Marketing, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Creative teams to align on priorities, shape product roadmaps, and lead the planning and execution of Growth Marketing initiatives—ensuring flawless delivery, clear accountability, and effective communication across all levels. Strategic Vision &amp; Hands-On Execution: Operate at both strategic and tactical levels—setting vision, defining KPIs, and rolling up your sleeves to support the execution and optimization of growth campaigns in-market.</li> <li>Insights &amp; Reporting: Build strong relationships with Japan Business and Marketing Teams and ensure alignment across initiatives. In regional leadership reviews, represent Growth Marketing, provide actionable insights, clear reporting, and thoughtful recommendations to guide strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your expertise: </strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Growth Marketing Expertise: 10+ years of&nbsp; relevant work experience in Growth Marketing&nbsp; (Search, CRM, Display, and Affiliate), with proven track record of scaling business for B2C brands ideally in fast-paced, global environments.&nbsp;</li> <li>Japan Market Mastery: Deep understanding of the Japan market, consumer trends, and digital behaviors, with experience tailoring strategies for Japan and working with local agencies and platforms.</li> <li>Analytical and Strategic: Expert at leveraging data to prioritize opportunities, drive decision-making, and measure business impact.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to influence and drive product conversations with engineering, design, creative and data science partners. Experience working with global channel owners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Project Management Excellence: Highly organized self-starter who thrives in dynamic environments; able to independently manage complex projects from strategy to execution.&nbsp;</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communicator who builds trust and alignment with senior leadership, peers, and global teams.</li> <li>Results-Driven: Relentless focus on outcomes, with a track record of delivering against ambitious goals through innovation, iteration, and hands-on execution.</li> <li>Technical Acumen: Familiarity with marketing automation, analytics tools, and digital platforms; able to translate business needs into technical requirements.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

Every day, Hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</p> <p>The Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACOE) at Airbnb, based in India, is a hub of knowledge and expertise that aims to provide data-driven decision-making, enabling Airbnb's business goals. The analyst must have deep functional expertise in building and scaling analytical solutions and serve as a strategic thought partner to product teams and business leaders across marketplace teams driving insights, recommendations, and data-informed decisions at scale. This role will sit under the Advanced Analytics family and support Business leaders within our Strategic Planning &amp; Operations organization.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary data thought partner to product and business leaders across Community Support, providing strategic insights, recommendations, and enabling data-informed decisions at an organizational level.</li> <li>Drive day-to-day product analytics and create scalable, reusable data tools and frameworks that elevate the entire team's analytical capability.</li> <li>Build and scale advanced analytical capabilities; leverage Airbnb's state-of-the-art machine learning infrastructure and central data science tools to collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and operations agents to achieve shared, cross-functional goals.</li> <li>Champion AI-first analytics practices across the team identifying high-impact opportunities to integrate LLM-based tools, AutoML, and advanced AI capabilities into analytical workflows.</li> <li>Demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and commitment to Airbnb's mission of belonging.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of how guests and hosts interact with our Community Support platform and how we can manage risk while meeting regulatory compliance requirements through structured and unstructured data sources.</li> <li>Mentor and guide junior analysts, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, curiosity, and continuous skill development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive the product analytics roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of solutions in the Strategic Planning &amp; Operations space, operating with minimal direction and planning up to 6 months ahead.</li> <li>Lead projects end-to-end: building timelines, defining key milestones, providing regular updates to product managers and analytics leadership, and delivering against agreed timelines.</li> <li>Work closely with Product Managers and Business leads to design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests; proactively identify and communicate common pitfalls and caveats of experimentation.</li> <li>Build credibility and trust with the team by building high-quality ground truth datasets and dashboards that empower stakeholders to answer data questions quickly and independently.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Engineering to spec out logging and with Analytics Engineering to build scalable data tools for mass consumption within Airbnb.</li> <li>Devise business metric frameworks and optimization models to support Airbnb's product, operations, and policy decisions at scale.</li> <li>Influence data-driven decisions across global sites and business verticals via business reviews, self-serve portals, planning scorecards, and impact analyses.</li> <li>Experiment with new Airbnb policy/product features to help deter and mitigate risk; translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership.</li> <li>Lead and influence machine learning model development in partnership with DS/Engineering teams to automate policy enforcement decisions, while routing the most complex cases for manual review.</li> <li>Proactively identify opportunities to apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., LLMs, AutoML, NLP pipelines) to accelerate analytical delivery and unlock new analytical capabilities.</li> <li>Ensure the availability of data quality and integrity for analysis and reporting by blending external and internal data sources, working closely with global operations and India analytics functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of industry experience with an advanced degree (Master's or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).</li> <li>&nbsp;Expert-level SQL; complex query optimization, performance tuning, and schema design; strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines; working knowledge of data transformation tools.</li> <li>Programming &amp; Statistical Modeling: Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, statsmodels); ability to build and deploy end-to-end analytical models; experience with advanced regression techniques, time-series analysis, and causal inference.</li> <li>Experimentation &amp; Analytical Frameworks: Expert-level A/B testing and multivariate testing; advanced experiment design including power analysis, switchback testing, and quasi-experimental methods (diff-in-diff, regression discontinuity); digital funnel and cohort analysis.</li> <li>Machine Learning &amp; AI (Proficient): Proficiency in ML techniques including EDA, hypothesis testing, linear/logistic regression, SVM, ridge/lasso regression, random forest, NLP, KNN, and K-means; hands-on experience with LLMs (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) and applied prompt engineering; ability to independently deploy AI tools to solve analytical problems; awareness of responsible AI, data privacy (GDPR/CCPA), and bias mitigation.</li> <li>Experience with forecasting and advanced econometric modeling is a requirement.</li> <li>Visualization &amp; Storytelling: Advanced proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent BI platforms; ability to design and build executive-level dashboards and self-serve analytics portals; strong data storytelling and presentation skills for senior leadership audiences.</li> <li>Data Foundations: Strong working knowledge of Presto, Hive, Teradata, and Spark; experience designing scalable data models for analytical consumption.</li> <li>AI tool proficiency: Independently applies AI tools (LLMs, AutoML, NLP pipelines) to solve complex business problems.</li> <li>Designs and implements AI-enhanced analytical workflows that can be adopted team-wide.</li> <li>Evaluates and selects appropriate AI models for specific use cases; understands trade-offs between model complexity, interpretability, and performance.</li> <li>Champions responsible AI principles including bias detection, model fairness, and compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA).</li> <li>Contributes to AI-first culture by sharing best practices, running enablement sessions, and identifying new AI use cases.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in a cross-cultural environment without direct authority.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills;&nbsp; able to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Proven track record of delivering full-stack data projects from inception to measurable business impact.</li> <li>Strong mentoring and coaching skills; demonstrated ability to develop junior talent.</li> <li>Positive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity.</li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving abilities, self-motivation, and autonomy; strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams and meet deadlines.</li> <li>Proficiency in agile project management practices and tools (e.g., Jira/Asana).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging</strong>:</p> <p>Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</p> <p>Please note, this role is based in Gurugram, India and relocation is not offered at this time.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p>Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">India Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>₹3,080,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>₹4,400,000 INR</span></div></div></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to join our team as the Payments Insights Analytics Lead. In this role, you will play a critical part in executing the strategic direction of Airbnb's Payments operations.</p> <p>Within this role, you will enable, facilitate, and assist in streamlining integrated data-driven decision making across the Payments Platform, Product, Operations organizations. The team is committed to operational excellence and Host and Guest experience through a culture of problem-solving, guided by data and research. We inject quantitative measurements into our user journey, product, processes and implement objective indicators of success. You will collaborate in the development and implementation of policies and procedures related to receiving and processing funds. Oversee the day to day operations in partnership with finance across collection, reconciliation and settlement (e.g., timely processing of payments motioning systems for issues). Collaboration will be a key aspect of this role, as you will work closely with cross-functional teams to drive process improvements and streamline payments data globally. Your ability to effectively communicate and build relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization will be essential in achieving our goals.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are passionate about solving complex problems within the Payments domain using data, insights, AI/ML models, and experimentation; adding a new perspective to existing solutions and making business decisions based on careful and thoughtful analysis</li> <li>You are highly proficient in building and analyzing analytical frameworks, statistical models and experimentation methods to establish and communicate causal relationships and drive measurable impact.</li> <li>You are a storyteller and technician that translates deeply technical analyses, and experimental results into compelling narratives that drive strategic business influence</li> <li>Ability to create impact for key&nbsp; projects at the eTeam direct level by iInfluencing strategy and roadmap through data-backed storytelling and actionable recommendations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A Typical Day</strong></p> <ul> <li>Generating payment reports and analyzing payment data for insights and performance evaluation</li> <li>Provide regular updates and reports to management and stakeholders, translating complex technical findings into business-friendly narratives and recommendations for leadership.</li> <li>Assist with analyzing payment performance and health, triaging the issue, and provide recommendation on the best course solution and optimization</li> <li>Design, execute, and analyze experiments to evaluate the impact of Payment strategies, product changes, and process improvements.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will collaborate on Financial Risk Management including losses, chargebacks and other cost components, and automation of payments processes</li> <li>Assist with initiatives to optimize the end-to-end payments journey by identifying pain points, friction areas, and improvement opportunities</li> <li>Collaborate with driving Host and Guest advocacy to enhance payment experience, amplifying voices and addressing concerns with impactful and measurable results</li> <li>Assist with building new payment strategies to balance financial risk and experience for different seller segments by utilizing advanced data analytics, AI/ML techniques to inform strategic decision-making</li> <li>Leverage experience across adjacent payment risk domains (trust &amp; safety, identity, fraud, compliance) to bring cross-functional insights and identify systemic patterns or opportunities.</li> <li>Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes in the payments landscape. Proactively identify opportunities for innovation</li> <li>Monitor payment trends, identify areas for improvement and implement strategies to optimize payments processing.&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide guidance to platform to maintain a robust and reliable payments infrastructure, contributing to the overall financial health of the business&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of industry experience in business analytics and a degree (Masters or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).</li> <li>Have experience supporting Payments teams and/or have worked closely with payments organizations, with demonstrated exposure to multiple payment risk domains such as trust &amp; safety, identity verification, fraud prevention, chargebacks, regulatory compliance, and financial risk management.</li> <li>Expert skills in SQL and expert in at least one programming language for data analysis (Python or R).&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with non-experimental causal inference methods, experimentation and machine learning techniques, ideally in a multi-sided platform setting</li> <li>Working knowledge of schema design and high-dimensional data modeling (ETL framework like Airflow)</li> <li>Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, you can distill highly technical work (model outputs, experimental results, complex data analyses) into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Ability to work under conditions of ambiguity in a fast-growth, sometimes uncertain and complex environment - comfortable acting with minimal planning, direction, and supervision. You can identify issues both within and outside of your immediate scope, and propose solutions.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Your Location:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position is US - Remote Eligible. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>Your Location:</strong></p> <p><strong>This position is CHINA BASED</strong>. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></p> <p>Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Community Support Products (CSP) Machine Learning team is the core team responsible for driving CSxAI (Customer Support x Artificial Intelligence) initiatives by adopting the Generative AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional service experience. The team develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and tools including LLM fine-tuning and optimization, RAG/Search,&nbsp; LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.&nbsp;</p> <p>The richness of Airbnb's data, the complexity of its marketplace and the variety innate in our product mean that we need to operate at the state of the art of AI practice. We are committed to investing in long&nbsp;term innovation to solve the complex problems we face, and to do that we need the very best experts in ML and AI to join us.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <p>We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.&nbsp;</p> <p>Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products</p> </li> <li> <p>Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience</li> <li>2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.&nbsp;</li> <li>Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products</li> <li>Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product &amp; design organizations</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></p> <p>Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</p>

and team performance, including identifying trends in performance, providing corrective actions and positive overall feedback, and writing year end reviews and improvement plans</li> <li>Ability to set and articulate the vision and focus for the quarter; deliver that vision and focus through all hands-type meetings</li> <li>Share input and recommendations about service target setting.</li> <li>Provide oversight on the overall service performance and contribute to reporting on trends and providing a holistic picture of the service to the Delivery Director</li> </ul> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of progressive experience in a customer service or an operations role, with 5 years in a role directly managing staff &amp; developing and implementing performance management standards</li> <li>Experience translating big picture goals and strategy into implementable and concrete actions for your teams, including setting operational or functional targets or performance goals&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to work weekend days, holidays, and on-call required</li> <li>Strong communicator, with fluency, in both written and spoken, English</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Your skills and competencies:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Exceptional leadership and team management skills to manage a team of professionals - comfort with conflict, giving and receiving feedback, and handling employee/Talent issues</li> <li>Strong communication skills to collaborate with different stakeholders and manage sensitive cases, while remaining calm and poised under pressure</li> <li>Organized and resourceful; You should have a strong independent work ethic and excellent communication skills, and an ability to take big ideas and translate them into policy with a positive and creative outlook. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience. The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.</p> <p>This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.</p> <p>This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <p>As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.</p> <p>You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.</p> <p>Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.</p> <p><strong>A Typical Day:</strong></p> <p><strong>Support the Office Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.</li> <li>Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.</li> <li>Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.</li> <li>Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.</li> <li>Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Coordinate Office Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.</li> <li>Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.</li> <li>Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.</li> <li>Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.</li> <li>Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.</li> <li>Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.</li> <li>Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.</li> <li>Support office utilization reporting.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Administrative Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.</li> <li>Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.</li> <li>Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.</li> <li>Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.</li> </ul> <p><em>This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.</em></p> <p><strong>Support Gatherings &amp; Connection</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.</li> <li>Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.</li> <li>Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.</li> <li>Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.</li> <li>Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build Strong Relationships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.</li> <li>Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.</li> <li>Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.</li> <li>Strong organizational and project coordination skills.</li> <li>Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and follow-through.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.</li> <li>Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.</li> <li>Full professional proficiency in English and Hindi.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Location:</strong></p> <p>This position needs to be based in the Gurugram office 5 days a week.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p>Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">India Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>₹1,610,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>₹2,300,000 INR</span></div></div></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p>Airbnb is redefining the world's approach to accommodation and travel. We are creating highly local, personal and authentic experiences for our host and guest community around the world. Our platform connects millions of people a year and furthers our mission to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere.</p> <p>To power the global Airbnb community, we are building a world-class payments platform - one that currently supports 191 countries, 63 currencies, connects dozens of payment providers and banks, and processes billions of dollars per year for all of Airbnb’s business units. As the platform grows, we’ll be adding new payment partners, establishing licensed payments companies around the world, and building innovative payment experiences and financial products for our guests and hosts. Our goal? To create a future where transparent, simple, and familiar payment solutions can empower people, entrepreneurs and communities on our global marketplace.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p> <p>Airbnb is seeking an experienced and strategic Payment Partnerships Manager to drive the vision, execution, and ongoing performance of our partner network supporting how we pay out to our global host community across 200+ markets. Reporting to the Head of Payment Partnerships, this role is pivotal in managing the partnerships that ensure our hosts are paid reliably, efficiently, compliantly and in alignment with our growth and platform goals.</p> <p>You will lead business development, deal negotiation, and strategic relationship management for a portfolio of high-value payment partners. With a focus on impact and long-term alignment, you'll help craft our partner landscape, structure and renegotiate commercial agreements, and serve as a critical voice in expanding and optimizing how payments to hosts are enabled around the world.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p>Strategic Partner Leadership</p> <ul> <li>Define and evolve our payout partner strategy in collaboration with the broader Payments, Product, Compliance and Finance teams to ensure coverage, performance, and alignment with Airbnb’s strategic and financial goals.</li> <li>Identify the right partners in each market, structure new deals, and renegotiate existing relationships to optimize for cost, reliability, reach, and innovation.</li> <li>Drive global deal execution for payouts—developing commercial structures, navigating regional regulatory constraints, and shaping contracts to meet Airbnb’s evolving needs.</li> </ul> <p>Relationship Management &amp; Performance</p> <ul> <li>Own and cultivate high-impact relationships with financial institutions, payment processors, banks, and other key partners, managing executive-level engagement to ensure Airbnb is a priority client.</li> <li>Monitor partner performance rigorously, identify gaps or opportunities, and lead cross-functional efforts to address issues or evolve terms.</li> <li>Lead strategic business reviews and act as the point of escalation and problem resolution for performance or operational misalignment.</li> </ul> <p>Global Payments Strategy &amp; Influence</p> <ul> <li>Assist in the ongoing scaling of Airbnb’s payout infrastructure—ensuring that partner decisions reflect regional needs, market conditions, cost structures, and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Legal, Treasury, Risk, Product, Engineering, and Global Operations to align execution with global strategy.</li> <li>Stay ahead of industry and macroeconomic changes affecting international payments and proactively bring forward opportunities and risk mitigation strategies.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in the payments or fintech industry, with at least 8 years in strategic partnerships, business development, or enterprise account management.</li> <li>Demonstrated success in owning commercial negotiations and managing multi-million dollar partnerships that balance customer experience, innovation, and financial return.</li> <li>Proven ability to craft and execute partner strategies that result in measurable business growth and process improvement.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of global payment methods, financial products, and cross-border payout solutions.</li> <li>Understanding of payments cost structure (e.g., interchange, chargebacks, FX, treasury flow), and experience optimizing it through partner levers.</li> <li>Experience in resolving partner conflicts or escalations, ideally across multiple markets or regulatory contexts.</li> <li>International payments experience, especially in marketplace or platform models.</li> <li>Experience in platform organizations advising internal stakeholders on partner enablement strategy.</li> <li>Experience working with regulators or regulated partners in cross-border payout environments.</li> <li>MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Your Location:</strong></span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><br></span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb Payments, Inc. (a subsidiary of Airbnb, Inc.) is a registered entity. Approved remote states include: Alabama, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Mississippi, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is excluded. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: </span><a style="color: #000000;" href="mailto:reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com"><span style="font-weight: 400;">reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. &nbsp;</span></p></div><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$168,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$210,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community you will join:</strong></p> <p>Airbnb’s Public Policy campaign team exists to further the interests of our community of hosts and guests with politicians, regulators, opinion leaders and others who shape the political and regulatory context for our business, helping them understand the significant social and economic contributions of our platform. Across the region, we are engaged in hundreds of local conversations and negotiations with governments big and small.&nbsp; We engage governments at local, state, provincial and national levels directly and also use innovative advocacy and partnership strategies that actively involve our community and stakeholders in making the case for fair, progressive home sharing rules.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <p>The main role of the Public Policy Manager is to ensure the conception and execution of successful policy campaigns in their assigned region.
